spec.name: Trend v17
spec.notes: Classic trend signal on trailing returns. Weekly rebalance.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 1.9, annual return 7%, maximum drawdown 12%.

charges.argument: The strategy's claimed performance is based on a single research-period backtest, which is susceptible to the knife-edge problem. This means the results may not be robust or generalizable to real-world conditions.
